the bare «وقال عبيد الله بن علي الحلبي:» makes him the first link (rule 10); the Imam is named in the words «سئل أبو عبد الله» and is the last link, written as the report names him (bare kunya, not identified); the asker is not named
«وَقَالَ عُبَيْدُ اَللَّهِ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ اَلْحَلَبِيُّ» — a bare «وقال X» with no transmitter before X: one link (rule 10)
«سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ» — the Imam is named in the words after the chain, so he is the last link, as written (owner ruling 2)
